mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE folder_path AS ( SELECT folder_id, parent_id, folder_level FROM kb_folder WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT f.folder_id, f.parent_id, f.folder_level FROM kb_folder f INNER JOIN folder_path fp ON f.folder_id = fp.parent_id WHERE f.del_flag = '0' ) SELECT fp.permission_id, fp.folder_id, fp.subject_type, fp.subject_id, fp.perm_view, fp.perm_download, fp.perm_edit, fp.perm_delete, fp.perm_upload, fp.perm_manage, fp.data_scope, fp.custom_scope, fp.inherit_flag FROM kb_folder_permission fp INNER JOIN folder_path f ON fp.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE fp.del_flag = '0' AND fp.inherit_flag = 1 AND fp.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND fp.subject_type = #{subjectType} ORDER BY f.folder_level DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT fp.permission_id, fp.folder_id, fp.subject_type, fp.subject_id, fp.perm_view, fp.perm_download, fp.perm_edit, fp.perm_delete, fp.perm_upload, fp.perm_manage, fp.data_scope, fp.custom_scope, fp.inherit_flag FROM kb_folder_permission fp WHERE fp.del_flag = '0' AND fp.folder_id = #{folderId}

WITH RECURSIVE folder_path AS ( SELECT folder_id, parent_id, folder_level FROM kb_folder WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT f.folder_id, f.parent_id, f.folder_level FROM kb_folder f INNER JOIN folder_path fp ON f.folder_id = fp.parent_id WHERE f.del_flag = '0' ) SELECT fp.permission_id, fp.folder_id, fp.subject_type, fp.subject_id, fp.perm_view, fp.perm_download, fp.perm_edit, fp.perm_delete, fp.perm_upload, fp.perm_manage, fp.data_scope, fp.custom_scope, fp.inherit_flag FROM kb_folder_permission fp INNER JOIN folder_path f ON fp.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE fp.del_flag = '0' AND fp.inherit_flag = 1 AND fp.subject_type = 1 AND fp.subject_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.folder_level DESC LIMIT 1
